decisionTiming: Requested after pass 3 collection; retrospective comparisons, with the original pre-collection A12/B12 test recorded separately.
algorithms: Unchanged A bilinear forward-surface inversion and B multiprototype local distance-weighted k-NN; no score-driven parameter tuning.
evaluation: Each combination is replayed on all three whole passes. A pass in the training set is labelled training_replay and NEVER included in held-out metrics. 123 has no held-out evaluation.
primary: 273 trimmed hold medians minus preceding row background per pass; equal weight per position. No future background, pose, target, guide, or temporal coordinate input.
secondary: Three correlated causal 0.12s frames per placement; end-background correction reported only as an offline diagnostic.
thresholdSuccess: Accepted AND radial error <= 2.5 or 5 mm, divided by all targets; rejected candidates remain in unconditional error statistics.
matchedLearningCurve: Hold out pass t; compare each of the other single passes with their pair on this same t. Pool the six singleton-to-test combinations versus three pair-to-test combinations descriptively, preserving separate fold tables. Test targets repeat across singleton comparisons; no independent n=1638 claim.
limits: Only three passes, one fixture pose and one desk setup. Different row orders and acquisition timing confound a universal data-size claim. Known grid coordinates, not unseen-space, arbitrary-pose, contact, or handwriting accuracy. No independent accuracy for 123. No significance claims.
